tool.brush.help: Brush (B): one cell at a time.
tool.broad.help: Broad brush (G): 2x2 cells at a time.
tool.fill.help: Fill (F): floods an area, as far as your paint goes.
tool.ruler.help: Ruler (L): drag for a perfectly straight line.
tool.knife.help: Palette knife (K): scrapes paint off. Right-click does too.
tool.dropper.help: Dropper (D): click a cell to mix its color.
tool.mirror.help: Mirror (M): strokes repeat across the middle.
paint.pick-first: Pick a pigment and mix it first.
paint.brush-dry: Your brush is dry. Mix more paint.
paint.pigment-dried-remix: Your {{pigment}} has dried. Mix it again.
paint.no-reference: No reference: paint whatever you like. Originals aren't judged.
paint.remix-hint: Click the color again to remix it.
paint.mix-help: Hold the mouse button (or Space) to lift your mix. Keep the hue inside it!
paint.controls: Left: paint   Right: scrape   1-0: pigments   Z: undo   Esc: leave
paint.leave.prompt: Stop painting? The canvas will be lost.
mix.off: The mix is a bit off.
mix.muddy: Muddy! That paint won't look right.
setup.prolific: Prolific: this one didn't use up a canvas!
setup.framed: Framed! Hang it on a wall.
setup.frame-hover: Turn a painting into wall decor. Uses a picture frame (you have {{frames}}).
setup.canvas-locked.small: Small canvases unlock at Painting level {{level}}.
setup.canvas-locked.medium: Medium canvases unlock at Painting level {{level}}.
setup.canvas-locked.large: Large canvases unlock at Painting level {{level}}.
setup.pick-one: Paint a still life: pick an item
setup.pick-many: Paint a still life: pick up to {{max}} items
setup.nothing-to-paint: Nothing in your bag to paint from.
setup.blank-canvas: A blank canvas. Paint whatever you like.
setup.mode-hover.relaxed: Relaxed: no light meter and no time pressure, sparks wait for you, flat colour on every canvas, and paint is free. Click to change.
setup.mode-hover.normal: Normal: a light meter that waits while you mix, mixed colours dry after a while, and paint comes from your Palette. Click to change.
setup.mode-hover.hard: Hard: the light never waits, the paint on your brush runs out, and sparks fade fast, for 20% more. Click to change.
setup.craft-small: Craft small canvases from fiber and wood.
setup.craft-big: Craft bigger canvases from cloth and wood.
setup.frame-title: Frame a painting to hang it on a wall
critique.light-gone-blank: The light went before you'd painted a thing.
critique.light-gone: The light went before you could finish it.
critique.original: An original. It's yours, whatever anyone says.
critique.great-muddy: Lovely work. A cleaner mix and it would sing.
critique.great: It looks just like the real thing.
critique.unrecognisable: Hmm... is this meant to be {{subject}}?
critique.muddy: The colors have gone muddy. Take more care at the palette.
critique.messy: It's nice, but there are stray marks all around it.
critique.shape: The colors are right, but the shape isn't quite {{subject}} yet.
critique.good: Very nice! A few colors aren't quite right, but it's charming.
critique.colors: That's the right shape, but the colors aren't there yet.
critique.sable.light-gone-blank: You ran out of light before you started. Everyone does once. Start smaller.
critique.sable.original: An original. Don't let anyone price it for you. Including me.
critique.sable.light-gone: You ran out of light. Everyone does. Paint the big shapes first.
critique.sable.great-muddy: Good bones. The mixing's muddy at the edges. Fix that and I'd hang it.
critique.sable.great: ...I'd hang that. I don't say that.
critique.sable.unrecognisable: Is that {{subject}}? Don't answer. Try again.
critique.sable.muddy: Your colors went muddy. Mud is just a color that got distracted.
critique.sable.messy: Stray marks. Every one you leave, the eye trips over.
critique.sable.shape: Right colors, wrong shape. Look at {{subject}} longer than you paint it.
critique.sable.good: Close. A few of those colors are guesses. Stop guessing.
critique.sable.colors: The shape's there. Now earn the colors.
results.capped: (your skill caps it here for now)
item.easel.description: Paint still lifes of anything you carry. Bring a canvas.
item.canvas.small.description: A stretched canvas, 20 cells square. Paint on it at an easel.
item.canvas.medium.description: A stretched canvas, 28 cells square: room for two things side by side.
item.canvas.large.description: A stretched canvas, 36 cells square: room for a whole arrangement.
item.frame.description: Frame one of your paintings at an easel to hang it on a wall.
item.pigment.description: Teaches you to mix {{pigment}}. Once learned, it's on your palette for good.
item.painting.description: A painting, made by hand at an easel.
brush.flat.description: A wide, flat brush. Each mix covers far more of the canvas.
brush.sable.description: A soft round brush that makes mixing more forgiving.
brush.rigger.description: A long, fine brush. Hues hold steadier, and inspiration lingers.
brush.iridium.description: A brush that seems to know where the paint should go.
skill.name: Painting
skill.level-up.broad: Broad brush: paint 2x2 cells at once
skill.level-up.ruler: Ruler: drag out perfectly straight lines
skill.level-up.mirror: Mirror: strokes repeat across the middle
skill.level-up.dropper: Dropper: click the canvas to pick its color
skill.level-up.medium: Medium canvases: still lifes of two items, portraits, and glazing
skill.level-up.large: Large canvases: still lifes of three items, and highlights
skill.level-up.quality: Your paintings can now reach {{quality}} quality
profession.plein-air.description: The light lasts {{percent}} longer and inspiration sparks come more often.
profession.steady-hand.description: Your mixes never turn muddy: at worst, they come out a bit off.
profession.visionary.description: An Inspired painting counts for twice as much toward its quality.
profession.patrons-favorite.description: Paintings you give as gifts earn {{percent}} more friendship.
profession.prolific.description: A {{chance}} chance that starting a painting doesn't use up the canvas.
shop.sign: Art Supply Shop^Canvases, pigments, brushes and frames. Paintings bought.^Open 10am to 6pm (Fridays till 5, Sundays from 1). Closed Wednesdays.
shop.trapdoor.locked: The trapdoor's bolted from below. It must lead down to Sable's room.
shop.yard-easel.busy: Sable's painting at it. Better not get in the light.
yard.watch.ask: Sable's working the canvas in thin washes. Stay and watch for a while?
yard.watch.done: You stayed. Most people get bored by the second wash.$h#$b#Watching is half of painting. The other half is ruining things.
yard.watch.again: Sable's lost in the painting. Best not to break the spell twice.
shop.counter: Welcome to the art supply shop.
shop.on-trust: A note on the till: "Take what you need. Money in the jar. -S"
commission.not-good-enough: It's lovely... but I was hoping for {{quality}}. Could you try again?
commission.taken: Commission taken: a painting of {{item}} for {{npc}}.
commission.lapsed: {{npc}}'s commission for a painting of {{item}} has lapsed.
commission.delivered.better: Oh, this is even better than I hoped! My {{item}}, exactly. Here's {{reward}}g, as promised.
commission.delivered: My {{item}} painting! It's just what I asked for. Here's {{reward}}g, thank you.
commission.needs.varnished: It's beautiful... but I'd hoped for one with a varnish on it. It'll last longer. Could you finish it?
commission.needs.glazed: Lovely! Only, I'd hoped for a glaze, that deep, layered colour. Could you try one with glazing?
board.title: Commission Board
board.note: Paint it, then hand it to them yourself.
board.empty: No new requests today. Check back tomorrow.
board.accept.hover: Deliver within {{days}} days for {{reward}}g and {{npc}}'s gratitude.
board.accept.full: You can only take on {{max}} commissions at a time.
sable.letter-answer.paint-first: I did what you said. I painted something first.
sable.letter-answer.stay: I stayed. And then I painted something.
config.intro: How much the easel asks of you at once.
config.difficulty.relaxed.description: No light meter. Mix each color once, then paint at your own pace.
config.difficulty.normal.description: Mixed colors dry after a while, so mix what you need and use it. The light only runs while you paint.
config.difficulty.hard.description: Paint runs out and must be remixed, the light never waits, sparks are fleeting. Pays 20% more.
config.light.description: Scales how long the light lasts, on top of the difficulty.
config.art-lovers.description: Leah, Elliott, Emily, Haley, Abigail, Sebastian, Sam, Robin and Sable like even a normal-quality painting. Turn off to make them as picky as everyone else.
pigment.learned: You learned to mix {{pigment}}. It's on your palette for good.
painting.time-passed: You lose track of time painting. It's {{time}}.
setup.too-late: Too late to start this one: you'd be painting past 2am.
setup.too-late-short: Too late in the day for this
item.palette.description: Holds {{tubes}} tubes' worth of each colour. Tubes you pick up go straight in. Keep it in your bag to paint; set it down and it stores paint like a chest.
item.tube.description: A tube of {{pigment}} paint: {{cells}} cells' worth. Refills your palette at the easel, and teaches you the colour if it's new.
item.mill.description: Grinds clay, flowers, berries, minerals and gems into tubes of paint overnight.
palette.refilled: You squeeze {{tubes}} tube(s) into your palette.
paint.out: You're out of {{pigment}}. Tubes from Sable or a Pigment Mill refill your palette.
setup.need-palette: You need a palette to paint. Craft one from 10 wood, or buy one from Sable.
setup.pick-portrait: Or paint a portrait of a friend:
setup.portrait-hover: A portrait of {{name}}. Needs a medium or large canvas, and takes an hour longer than a still life.
setup.portrait-canvas: A portrait needs a medium or large canvas.
painting.provenance.sitter: A portrait of {{name}}, painted from life
commission.delivered.portrait: Is that really how I look? ...I love it. Here's {{reward}}g, thank you.
commission.delivered.portrait.better: Oh! You've made me look like I'm about to say something clever. Here's {{reward}}g, and then some gratitude.
setup.pick-view: Or paint the view from here:
setup.pick-view-or-portrait: Or paint the view, or a friend:
setup.view-hover:
The view of {{place}}
Painted en plein air: the whole canvas, an hour longer, and worth more somewhere far-flung, in bad weather or after dark.
catalogue.milestone.tubes: {{count}} subjects painted! Sable sent three tubes of aquamarine.
catalogue.milestone.palette: {{count}} subjects painted! Your palette's wells now hold half as much again.
catalogue.milestone.renown: {{count}} subjects painted! Your name sells: paintings are worth 10% more.
catalogue.milestone.iridium: {{count}} subjects painted! Expect a letter from Sable tomorrow.
shop.counter.consign: Leave paintings with Sable to sell
consign.closed: There's nobody at the counter to take a painting.
consign.title: Consign at the gallery
consign.note: Sable shows up to {{max}} of your paintings on the easels. Each sells within one to three days (the better it is, the sooner) for more than any shop pays. Take one back any time before then.
consign.no-paintings: You have no paintings with you.
consign.hover:
Click to leave it with Sable.
Should fetch about {{price}}g.
record.title: Your painting record
record.note: New subjects sell for more; the same one again in a week, for less (until Monday).
record.empty: Nothing yet. Every subject you paint will be kept here.
record.milestones.next: Different subjects painted: {{left}} more to the next milestone.
record.reward-hover.tubes: Three tubes of aquamarine paint (and the colour).
record.reward-hover.palette: Every Palette's wells hold half as much again.
record.reward-hover.renown: Every painting you make is worth 10% more.
record.reward-hover.iridium: A letter from Sable, with an iridium brush.
item.varnish.description: A tin of amber varnish. Put a painting in a Varnishing Cabinet with one, and it cures to a finish that's worth more.
item.cabinet.description: Cures a varnished painting over weeks: satin after 7 days, gloss after 14, a gallery finish after 28. Hit it with a tool to take a painting out early.
varnish.already: That painting has already been varnished.
varnish.need-tin: You need a tin of Varnish to varnish a painting.
varnish.empty: A varnishing cabinet. Use it while holding a painting, with a tin of Varnish in your bag.
varnish.status: {{painting}}: {{finish}}. {{days}} more days to a {{next}}.^(Hit the cabinet with a tool to take it out now.)
tool.glaze.help: Glaze (T): a thin dark wash over paint that's already down. The dotted cells in the reference want one.
tool.highlight.help: Highlight (H): a dab of thick, light paint. Put highlights on last: painting beside one smears it.
technique.explain.glaze: New on this canvas: glazing. The darker, shaded cells in the reference are glazed. Paint the colour, then glaze over it (Glaze tool, T).
technique.explain.highlight: New on this canvas: highlights. A few bright spots take a dab of thick paint (Highlight tool, H). Do them last: painting beside one smears it.
technique.needs-paint: The {{tool}} goes over paint: paint the cell first.
technique.smeared: Smeared a highlight! Highlights go on last.
item.linen.description: Fine linen, stretched and primed. Paints like any canvas, but only on linen can a painting become a Masterpiece.
setup.linen-hover: Paint on a linen canvas. Only linen can make a Masterpiece: an iridium painting, five stars, Inspired, with its glazes and highlights in place.
sable.masterpiece-gift: ...Oh.$h#$b#Do you know what this is? Most painters go their whole lives without one of these. I'm hanging it where I can see it from the counter.$l
skill.level-up.varnish: Varnish: a cabinet that cures paintings to a finer finish
skill.level-up.linen: Linen canvases: the only ones a Masterpiece can be painted on
palette.stored.many: {{tubes}} tubes of paint went into your {{palette}}.
palette.full: No room for another tube of {{pigment}}.
palette.menu.note: Holds {{tubes}} of each colour. Click a colour to take a tube out; click a tube below to put it in (shift-click: the whole stack).
palette.menu.no-tubes: You have no tubes of paint with you.
palette.menu.put-in: Click: put one in. Shift-click: all that fit.
palette.menu.take-out: Click to take a tube out.
palette.menu.not-a-tube: Not enough for a whole tube.
married.farm-painting: I was out at the patio easel yesterday while you worked.$h#$b#It's the farm. Our farm. Take it before I start fixing the sky again.
married.wall.0: Your {{painting}} catches the morning light where you hung it. I keep stopping to look.$h
married.wall.1: I looked at your {{painting}} over breakfast. You've got braver with your colours.$h
married.wall.2: Your {{painting}}... I'd have hung it a little higher. But I'd have hung it.$u
married.wall.3: Sometimes I forget your {{painting}} is yours and start critiquing it. Then I remember, and keep critiquing it.$h
